extractions.value: Patient had been on penicillamine for the previous decade, a drug that can provoke autoimmune disorders such as myasthenia gravis and neuromyotonia. A left quadriceps muscle biopsy demonstrated angular and fascicular atrophy suggesting denervation; fascial and perimysial alkaline and acid phosphatase reactivity indicated vascular or fascial inflammation, or both, but no inflammatory cells were observed. A hyperosmolar, nonketotic state developed after prednisone increase, treated with insulin; some paranoia occurred but decreased when prednisone dosage was decreased.
